## Validation

## Permissions and privacy

- [ ] Permission and host-access changes reviewed, or explicitly recorded as none.
- [ ] Any new access has a written reason, narrower alternatives considered, and matching manifest, README, privacy, and decision updates.
- [ ] Privacy impact reviewed: no answer collection/submission, unrelated browsing inspection, sensitive fixtures/logs, or retained question/choice content.
